sloka: तस्य मे स्वर्गभूतस्य क्षुत्पिपासे द्विजोत्तम ।बाधेते परमोदार ततो ऽहं व्यथितेन्द्रियः ।गत्वा त्रिभुवनश्रेष्ठं पितामहमुवाच ह ।। ७.७८.११ ॥
transliteration: tasya me svargabhūtasya kṣutpipāse dvijottama ।bādhete paramodāra tato 'haṁ vyathitendriyaḥ ।gatvā tribhuvanaśreṣṭhaṁ pitāmahamuvāca ha ।। 7.78.11 ॥

translations.english: O best of Brahmins and most generous one, even after attaining heaven, hunger and thirst afflicted me, causing my senses distress, so I went and spoke to the grandfather, Brahma, the best of the three worlds.
